title: Customer Insights Analyst
text: Customer Insights Analyst at Foxtel Management Pty Limited (Sydney, Ryde & Macquarie Park; Full Time; salary: not stated). Our purpose at Foxtel is to effortlessly connect Australians to all the stories they love. We believe Foxtel is for everyone, and everyone deserves to experience all the entertainment, drama, sport, news and lifestyle content they want - when they want, and how they want. At Foxtel we work as a team, we’re agile and we’re accountable. We put the customer first and we’re passionate about what we do. We have fun and we’re different, better, special. Join us as a Customer Insight Analyst working with business stakeholders and analysts from across the business to become a trusted partner in the delivery of insightful recommendations to meet stakeholder needs. Your purpose Work with business stakeholders to identify key analysis needs and provide guidance on solutions Develop and implement marketing and customer analysis which will increase ability to provide speed to market, enable decision making and address key business challenges Design and develop customer reporting which track success of projects and initiatives Deliver to deadlines by managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and demanding environment Present insights from analysis and recommendations in a clear way that the business can action Build analytics solutions that address marketing and customer challenges and enable go to market activities Proactively work with business stakeholders to implement processes to allow testing and roll-out of the solutions Provide end to end management of analysis from briefing to solution recommendation Build strong relationships within the analytics community to leverage experience from other teams and minimise duplicative efforts Your capability Proficient in SQL, SPSS (or similar) and understanding of analytics techniques such as regression, decision trees, cohort analysis, driver analysis and customer lifetime value Experience in strategic planning of analysis needed to address business challenges Demonstrated experience in planning and executing large analysis projects in stages and presenting results back to stakeholders Successful development and execution of customer, product and marketing analysis to answer business questions Experience in working with large volumes and complexity of data, and cleansing where needed Working knowledge and participation in agile and scrum team preferred Excellent skills in interpretation of data to generate succinct and actionable insights Highly developed stakeholder management skills with ability to autonomously manage stakeholders and influence decisions Demonstrated experience in autonomous end to end management of analysis projects What’s in it for you? We have a benefits program with something for everyone. But we’re in the entertainment business and we connect Australians to all the stories they love, so what would a Foxtel benefits program be without a free Foxtel subscription and discounted broadband! Above all, we love entertainment and, if you do too, you’ll love working with us. So if you’re excited about this opportunity, please click ‘Apply now’.
